title: Research: A4 four-output target has no six-call word
body:
## Result

**Scoped exact negative result; no new `kappa`.** In the full formal group algebra `F2[A4]`, the four-output target `diag([a],[b],[aba^-1b^-1],[ab])` has no word of length at most six in the stated 240-factor alphabet. Its separate-role direct construction costs eight calls. This excludes the proposed two-call saving; a seven-call word remains open, so this is not an exact-minimum claim.

Set `a=(123)` and `b=(124)`. Each paid factor is `I+([g]+[1])N` for `g in {a,b}` and any rank-one idempotent `N=xy^T` in `M4(F2)`. The direct word uses labels `a`, `b`, `abba`, and `ab` on the four roles.

## Exact evidence

The `A4/V4 ~= C3` determinant character screens impossible label-count classes. Exact acceptance compares all 16 matrix entries with all 12 A4 coefficients. The 3+3 join stores all 13,881,841 right prefixes through length three, deduplicates to 6,697,991 exact states, and checks all 13,881,841 left prefixes. The planted six-call join control and the direct eight-call word pass. The independent Python replay reconstructs the group and target, checks all 48 regular basis inputs, rejects all eight one-call omissions, a missing fourth output, and a mutated fourth label. The earlier three-output target is verified separately at its corrected six-call direct cost, with zero saving.

Reproduce from the repository root:

```sh
python3 -I -B research/a4-commutator-four-role-seed-dcbf/verify.py
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/a4-commutator-four-role-seed-dcbf --check-only
```

Both commands pass locally under Python 3.14.7; the verifier compiled with g++ 16.2.0 and warnings as errors. The registered package replay requests Python 3.12, which is not installed locally.
